subject: af-td
title: AF.TD.------V.SY.
description: Chart on book p. 98 (CS-26). AF-TD (affinity tendencies) is the subject; V-SY (value system) is the partner. From the subject: POL-DY (political dynamics), INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and APL-DT (application dictates). From POL-DY: POL-P (political policies), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INDIV-TD: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From SOC-RT-P: PART (participation). From APL-DT: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From RT-INT-TR: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics).
